description: This Java class 'ClientSearchService' provides search functionalities for clients based on text input within the Fineract project. It includes methods to validate search requests and execute text-based searches using the client repository, with security and pagination support.

classes.name: ClientSearchService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling client search operations based on text input, enforcing security, and pagination.

methods.name: searchByText
methods.description: Public method to perform a text-based search for clients, validates the request, and executes the search.

methods.name: validateTextSearchRequest
methods.description: Validates that the search request is not null and the user is authenticated.

methods.name: executeTextSearch
methods.description: Performs the search query against the client repository, applying hierarchy and pagination, and maps results.
